description: alicecallanan/ev-load-profiles-sweden: EV Charging Profiles Initial Release is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Alice Callanan. Release Overview This release provides the synthetic Electric Vehicle (EV) charging load profiles generated for the study "A data-driven probabilistic framework for estimating grid impacts of EV charging at scale" (published in IJEPES, 2025). Contents Hourly Profiles: Power demand in kW for each Swedish DeSO region. Statistical Analysis: Descriptive statistics (mean, max, percentiles) per zone. Coverage: national (SE); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
